answers.this_leg_cannot_speak_for: counts whose value no sibling proves (the `gap` = 71 case) stay unmeasurable here

caveats: an equal length is a WITNESS, not a proof: a parent with five members and a leaf that happens to be 5 matches without the two being related
values below 2 are skipped because a 0 or a 1 matches any single-member sibling by accident; the floor is a line this leg draws and the skipped count is published beside the finding
the corpus is the newest 1200 results faces under the size cap, so the totals are a floor on the surface, never a claim of completeness
only leaves whose NAME carries a measurement token are split by the count-word test; witnessed counts under other names are reported as one total because the quote hazard does not reach them
the two totals answer different questions: 'witnessed' is how many counts prove themselves, 'word_caught' is how many of the measurement-named ones the vocabulary already recognised
